lines.text: Jesus says nations will be bewildered by the roaring of the sea, and men will faint from fear.
They will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud, so Jesus says to stand up.
Jesus tells a parable of the fig tree: when it sprouts leaves, you know that winter is near.
Jesus warns that the worries of life weigh hearts down and that the day comes like a snare.
Every day Jesus taught at the temple, and every evening He spent the night on the Mount of Sinai.
